mandatory.description: shall be subject to human resources development levy at 1% of the monthly wage of the employee.

optional.description: shall pay a levy for each of his employee at the rate of 0.5% of the monthly wages of the employee.

excluded: Travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession
Fund/scheme contribution to employee benefits or welfare.
Travel allowances including petrol and transport allowances
Attendance allowance (for which the amount changes from month-to=month)

notes: LEVY = [(BASIC SALARY - UNPAID LEAVE) + FIXED ALLOWANCE] x 1%
